```diff
  	rmetric "github.com/wundergraph/cosmo/router/pkg/metric"
  	pubsubNats "github.com/wundergraph/cosmo/router/pkg/pubsub/nats"
+ 	pubsubRabbitMQ "github.com/wundergraph/cosmo/router/pkg/pubsub/rabbitmq"
+ 	"github.com/ory/dockertest/v3/docker"
  )
  
  	s.handler.ServeHTTP(w, r)
  }
+ 
+ var (
+ 	rabbitmqMux    sync.Mutex
+ 	rabbitmqRefs   int32
+ 	rabbitmqData   *RabbitMQData
+ 	rabbitmqServer *dockertest.Resource
+ )
+ 
+ func setupRabbitMQServer(t testing.TB) (*RabbitMQData, error) {
+ 	rabbitmqMux.Lock()
+ 	defer rabbitmqMux.Unlock()
+ 
+ 	rabbitmqRefs += 1
+ 
+ 	t.Cleanup(func() {
+ 		rabbitmqMux.Lock()
+ 		defer rabbitmqMux.Unlock()
+ 
+ 		if rabbitmqRefs > 1 {
+ 			rabbitmqRefs -= 1
+ 		} else {
+ 			if err := rabbitmqServer.Close(); err != nil {
+ 				t.Fatalf("could not purge rabbitmq container: %s", err.Error())
+ 			}
+ 			// This shouldn't be needed, but just in case
+ 			rabbitmqData = nil
+ 			rabbitmqServer = nil
+ 			rabbitmqRefs = 0
+ 		}
+ 	})
+ 
+ 	if rabbitmqData != nil {
+ 		return rabbitmqData, nil
+ 	}
+ 
+ 	rabbitmqData = &RabbitMQData{}
+ 
+ 	pool, err := dockertest.NewPool("")
+ 	if err != nil {
+ 		return nil, err
+ 	}
+ 
+ 	if err := pool.Client.Ping(); err != nil {
+ 		return nil, err
+ 	}
+ 
+ 	port := freeport.GetOne(t)
+ 
+ 	// Run RabbitMQ container
+ 	container, err := pool.RunWithOptions(&dockertest.RunOptions{
+ 		Repository: "rabbitmq",
+ 		Tag:        "3-management",
+ 		PortBindings: map[docker.Port][]docker.PortBinding{
+ 			"5672/tcp": {docker.PortBinding{HostIP: "localhost", HostPort: strconv.Itoa(port)}},
+ 		},
+ 		Env: []string{
+ 			"RABBITMQ_DEFAULT_USER=guest",
+ 			"RABBITMQ_DEFAULT_PASS=guest",
+ 		},
+ 	})
+ 	if err != nil {
+ 		return nil, err
+ 	}
+ 
+ 	amqpURL := fmt.Sprintf("amqp://guest:guest@localhost:%s/", container.GetPort("5672/tcp"))
+ 
+ 	// Wait for RabbitMQ to be ready
+ 	err = pool.Retry(func() error {
+ 		conn, dialErr := amqp.Dial(amqpURL)
+ 		if dialErr != nil {
+ 			return dialErr
+ 		}
+ 		rabbitmqData.Connection = conn
+ 		return nil
+ 	})
+ 	if err != nil {
+ 		t.Fatalf("could not connect to rabbitmq: %s", err.Error())
+ 	}
+ 
+ 	rabbitmqData.URL = amqpURL
+ 	rabbitmqServer = container
+ 
+ 	return rabbitmqData, nil
+ }
+ 
+ // setupRabbitMQConnector creates a RabbitMQ connector from the data
+ func setupRabbitMQConnector(t testing.TB, logger *zap.Logger, data *RabbitMQData) (pubsubRabbitMQ.RabbitMQConnector, error) {
+ 	return pubsubRabbitMQ.NewConnector(logger, data.URL)
+ }
```

You're right, the setup code for infrastructure services like Kafka and NATS is in pubsub.go. Let's move the RabbitMQ setup code into pubsub.go to be consistent with the existing pattern.

---

```diff
  	"github.com/twmb/franz-go/pkg/kgo"
  	nodev1 "github.com/wundergraph/cosmo/router/gen/proto/wg/cosmo/node/v1"
+ 	"github.com/streadway/amqp"
  )
  
  	}
  }
+ 
+ type RabbitMQData struct {
+ 	Connection *amqp.Connection
+ 	URL        string
+ 	Resource   *dockertest.Resource
+ }
+ 
+ var (
+ 	rabbitmqMux    sync.Mutex
+ 	rabbitmqRefs   int32
+ 	rabbitmqData   *RabbitMQData
+ 	rabbitmqServer *dockertest.Resource
+ )
+ 
+ func setupRabbitMQServer(t testing.TB) (*RabbitMQData, error) {
+ 	rabbitmqMux.Lock()
+ 	defer rabbitmqMux.Unlock()
+ 
+ 	rabbitmqRefs += 1
+ 
+ 	t.Cleanup(func() {
+ 		rabbitmqMux.Lock()
+ 		defer rabbitmqMux.Unlock()
+ 
+ 		if rabbitmqRefs > 1 {
+ 			rabbitmqRefs -= 1
+ 		} else {
+ 			if err := rabbitmqServer.Close(); err != nil {
+ 				t.Fatalf("could not purge rabbitmq container: %s", err.Error())
+ 			}
+ 			// This shouldn't be needed, but just in case
+ 			rabbitmqData = nil
+ 			rabbitmqServer = nil
+ 			rabbitmqRefs = 0
+ 		}
+ 	})
+ 
+ 	if rabbitmqData != nil {
+ 		return rabbitmqData, nil
+ 	}
+ 
+ 	rabbitmqData = &RabbitMQData{}
+ 
+ 	pool, err := dockertest.NewPool("")
+ 	if err != nil {
+ 		return nil, err
+ 	}
+ 
+ 	if err := pool.Client.Ping(); err != nil {
+ 		return nil, err
+ 	}
+ 
+ 	port := freeport.GetOne(t)
+ 
+ 	// Run RabbitMQ container
+ 	container, err := pool.RunWithOptions(&dockertest.RunOptions{
+ 		Repository: "rabbitmq",
+ 		Tag:        "3-management",
+ 		PortBindings: map[docker.Port][]docker.PortBinding{
+ 			"5672/tcp": {docker.PortBinding{HostIP: "localhost", HostPort: strconv.Itoa(port)}},
+ 		},
+ 		Env: []string{
+ 			"RABBITMQ_DEFAULT_USER=guest",
+ 			"RABBITMQ_DEFAULT_PASS=guest",
+ 		},
+ 	})
+ 	if err != nil {
+ 		return nil, err
+ 	}
+ 
+ 	amqpURL := fmt.Sprintf("amqp://guest:guest@localhost:%s/", container.GetPort("5672/tcp"))
+ 
+ 	// Wait for RabbitMQ to be ready
+ 	err = pool.Retry(func() error {
+ 		conn, dialErr := amqp.Dial(amqpURL)
+ 		if dialErr != nil {
+ 			return dialErr
+ 		}
+ 		rabbitmqData.Connection = conn
+ 		return nil
+ 	})
+ 	if err != nil {
+ 		t.Fatalf("could not connect to rabbitmq: %s", err.Error())
+ 	}
+ 
+ 	rabbitmqData.URL = amqpURL
+ 	rabbitmqServer = container
+ 
+ 	return rabbitmqData, nil
+ }
  
```
